'''Smitroo Industries''', also known as the '''Smitroo Corporation''', was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company which closed during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after filing for bankruptcy.

==History==
A [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company active during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] early years, Smitroo Industries was responsible for producing only five hundred [[Explorer Mk. V]] droids before filing for bankruptcy and closing down all of its factories. Despite the fact that the [[Smitroo Board of Directors|Board of Directors]] had disbanded, the surviving droids continued searching for their creators in an attempt to receive exploration mission instructions. During their search, many of these droids joined the Republic's [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]].<ref name="GG8" />
